shadow_mode.description: Evaluate without sending replies (still calls the model)

all_groups.description: Explicitly enable all group chats; source AI settings still apply. False uses the exact allowlist.

allowed_groups.description: Used when all_groups=false: exact platform_id|bot_id|group_id entries; empty enables no groups in that mode

persona_id.description: Existing persona ID; required, no fallback

message_chars.description: Maximum characters per observation; 0 disables text truncation

context_chars.description: Maximum serialized batch prompt characters; 0 disables. Drop old background first, never silently drop pending IDs; oversize pending batches are retried smaller.

attempt_interval.description: Minimum seconds between attempts, including silence and errors

reply_cooldown.description: Minimum seconds between local live replies

timeout.description: Total seconds for provider lookup, persona lookup and generation

max_groups.description: Maximum concurrent physical group workers in batch mode; additional rooms stay durably queued

diagnostics_enabled.description: Opt-in private JSONL of evaluated inputs, prompts, model reply text and decisions. Disable after the trial; do not publish records.

batch_mode.description: Use durable per-message batch judgments; false selects the legacy non-covering snapshot algorithm

batch_size.description: Maximum pending messages per model request (1–128); invalid responses halve the retry batch

batch_retry_base.description: Initial retry delay in seconds (0–60 exclusive of zero), exponential up to 60 seconds
